decisive_items: Revealed endometrial glands consisting of a single layer of monomorphous cuboidal cells with an endometrial stroma
A subcutaneous nodule of approximately 1 cm diameter was present under the hypogastrium.
The mass was accompanied by slight pain that worsened around menstruation.
response.rationale: Only R1 was supplied, so no true pairwise contrast was possible. R1 is strongly supported by diagnostic histopathologic findings of endometrial glands and stroma in a subcutaneous abdominal-wall nodule, with clinical features of cyclic pain and a lower abdominal location compatible with abdominal wall endometrioma.
